title: Unforked — OuroSSS is now standalone
body: Deleted fork dependency on razzant/ouroboros, recreated as fresh standalone repo. Clean slate: v0.0.1, zero issues, main branch only.

title: TTHRESH research bootstrapped
body: Tucker tensor compression rewrite in JAX — differentiable HOSVD with learned factor matrices. Assessment moved from PR to Notion, repo initialized on kurkin-1.

title: Migrated to uv + pyproject.toml
body: Full uv dependency management with lockfile, pre-commit hooks, ruff linting. Entry point via `uv run ourosss`. 19 commits in a single day of restructuring.

title: Telegram chat organizer + research commands
body: New /tg-organize for folder management and bulk archive. /research command for Notion research log DB. Issue routing protocol established.

title: Async CI for research pipeline
body: GitHub Actions workflows for async research pipeline stages. Bot disk alerts, command cleanup, Notion status types fixed.

title: GitHub Pages site launched
body: Research portfolio live at fr0do.github.io. Auto-updating vitals via /page Telegram command. Apple-minimalist design, zero dependencies.

title: OuroSSS bootstrapped
body: Initial meta-project: OUROBOROS.md governance protocol, Telegram bot (19 commands), multi-agent orchestration, CI/CD automation.
